title: Unequal endpoint values and a cusp · Set 3
statement:
Find the absolute maximum value of $|x-[$a]|+3$ on $[-1,2([$a])+4]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Evaluate the left and right endpoints in the original function.
Choose the endpoint farther from the cusp.
solution: The left value is $[$a]+4$ and the right value is $[$a]+7$, so the right endpoint gives the maximum.

feedback.message: Choose the endpoint farther from the cusp.
